snippet.title: Cosmo Cat: A Cozy Desktop Idler – Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Cosmo Cat is out now on Steam! 10% off at launch 🐱🌌
▶ https://store.steampowered.com/app/5034300?utm_source=youtube

A cozy desktop idle game: your own space cat floats beside you while you work, and each day becomes a constellation.

✦ Lives on your desktop — no fullscreen needed. It keeps going in a corner while you work.
✦ Idle rewards — leave it on screen and stardust piles up.
✦ Starlight Exploration — a focus timer that sends your cat off to explore.
✦ Make it yours — eyes, brows, mouth, pattern, hat and a little pet.
✦ Daily constellations — every day you spend together is drawn in the stars.
✦ Friends — invite friends into your space and explore together.
